description: F-HW-05 — 1/4 NPT pipe-tap × 1 on a 60×60×40 block (spec §8.5). Pure data: pipe-tap holeSpec + manual single-position. Worker side (/occt/op/hole/pipe-tap) is blocked until occt-worker src/ provision (Wave 1 task #31); W5 — Track C5 ships the client-side data model + Type/Size UI extensions. The cosmetic NPT taper is rendered by the existing C4 SVG; pipeTapClass + taperAngle fields are new in W5.
notes: Spec §8.5 reference: 1/4 NPT (Ø 11.4 minor, 9.7 mm engagement) centered on the top face of a 60×60×40 block with a 5 mm fillet on the top edge.

W5 introduces pipeTapClass + taperAngle as optional fields on PipeTapHoleSpec; legacy fixtures (F-HW-01..F-HW-04) remain untouched. Default class is derived from the series (NPT → 'NPT', BSP → 'BSP_parallel'), the wizard's Size-tab class picker can override.
taperAngle 1.7833° (1°47′) is the cosmetic half-angle used by the C4 SVG renderer; the worker cut at this phase is plain cylindrical, taper is render-only per spec §8.5.
Worker endpoint /occt/op/hole/pipe-tap is blocked on Wave 1 task #31; this fixture pins the body shape so wire-up after worker provision matches the wizard's expectation.
The wizard's Type tab selects 'Pipe Tap', Size tab picks 1/4-18 from the NPT catalog, Termination Blind 12 mm, Position Manual at (30, 30).
DFM: TAP_BOTTOM_RISK rule is scoped to kind=tap; pipe_tap deliberately bypasses it (engagementDepth + bore termination governed separately by the pipe spec).
